name: javacssmonoaks-css-build
description: CSS optimization pipeline for AKS production container (cz-css-1004 + cz-css-1005 + cz-css-1008 + cz-css-1011)

scripts.compile:preprocessors: npm run compile:scss && npm run compile:less
scripts.build:css: for f in purged/styles/*.css; do npx postcss "$f" --use cssnano -o "dist/styles/$(basename $f)"; done
scripts.optimize:css: npm run compile:preprocessors && npm run purge:css && npm run build:css
